The '''''Fricasseed Nerf''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was used during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The ''Nerf'' was owned by [[Hedrett Shipping and Investments]] and used data supplied by the [[Comet Broom Service]], to allow it to travel through safe routes through the [[Cularin comet cloud]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. However, when the Service provided the crew of the ''Nerf'' with inaccurate information, the ship collided with a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] fragment and was left drifting in space. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] found the ''Nerf'' and managed to save it.

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Nerf'' was captained by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jyn N'oram]] and her co-pilot was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[D'yra Calisse]]. The Human [[Vicca Drane]] and the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Josa Kenn]] also served on the ship.
